summary: Fix confirmed. At afa7f1e5d049 (the fix parent and the only affected commit), running examples/transformers_integration.py unmodified, with its transformers imports succeeding (transformers 4.52.4), raised ImportError "cannot import name 'patch_transformers' from 'exllamav3.integration'" at examples/transformers_integration.py:6; nothing was registered. At the fix 72bdf5a39c35 the import succeeded and patch_transformers() registered 'exl3' in transformers' AUTO_QUANTIZER_MAPPING; the example then stopped at line 26, where from_pretrained rejects its hard-coded local model path '/mnt/str/models/llama3.1-70b-instruct/exl3/1.6bpw_H3/' (HFValidationError), which does not exist here. That later failure is beyond the trigger.

Environment py312-compareq-torch26cu126 (real transformers 4.52.4), native extension built for the tree (same tree at both commits). Ran on the GPU machine, but the trigger itself needs no GPU.
